connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.verityskills.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cchurctrip account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
